exact_statement: For every nonconstant Boolean source g on a>=1 uniform bits, b>=1 independent padded data bits, r>=1 fresh point controls, every edited point, and every source subprobability R of mass s<=1 positive on P_g support with finite complete cost c<=C0 I_g (C0>=0), put n=a+b,p=2^-r,t=2^-n,F=g-2g(y*)1_(controls=x*)1_(data=y*,padding=z*) and K=4C0+15. Start with the original general-envelope floor (Rpad+6pt U_n)/(1+6pt) lifted by the true conditional selector kernel. Query any ell=1..b padded bits, in any adaptive order on the unique branch matching the edit, stopping all other branches at g and its ORIGINAL source reference R. Prescribe the same envelope on the surviving branch using original R and beta_ell=6p2^ell t, not a newly certified descendant source. The complete signed reset ledger L_ell=CE_root+sum_(j<ell)2^-j[avg D(child||fresh_child)-D(parent||current)] equals sum reach DeltaH+sum_leaves reach CE_fresh and H(F)+sum_leaves reach D_fresh, including all subprobability normalizers and both terminals. It obeys L_ell<=(1+2^-ell)c+2pt[15(n+r-ell)+ell(n+r+8)-ell(ell-1)/2]<=(3/2)c+(41/4)I_g. The physical erased-edge term is E<=p2^-b I_g<=I_g/4 and I(F)>=3I_g/4, so K I(F)-L_ell>=((3/2)C0+1)I_g>0. Hence every prescribed fresh reset is paid from the SAME unused root remainder K I(F)-CE_root, with this displayed final margin, without a renewed source bank or rate inflation. An independent arbitrary Boolean terminal with prescribed finite-cost subprobability reference adds exactly its complete cost and divergence and multiplies model masses. Every terminal is nonconstant. No query that changes the source core and no full FEI theorem is asserted; integer rounding is separate.
